name: s2_language_control
title: The language control is readable and moves the critic; the NLA states it, Oracle Lens only writes in it
caption: French vs German, the control row, through each instrument. Readable = linear-probe AUROC on the layer-42 activation (0.80 bar); statement shift through the NLA critic (dot = the fixed statement, whisker = min to max over 8 paraphrase pairs; 0.30 bar, since withdrawn); J-enrichment of the class-mean direction in the top-1536 J-space (1.5 bar; pale = below it); free readouts = share of 320 readouts (40 items x 8) a judge marked as stating the language or as written in it, item-clustered bootstrap 95%. Open = exp 12 bank (exp 02 for J-enrichment), filled = exp 18 bank. The NLA states the language on 0.81 to 0.95 of readouts; Oracle Lens writes in it but never says it. Caveat: exp 18's own J-enrichment instrument gives 1.38, under the 1.5 bar.

notes: Readable: exp 18 from instruments18.json (0.9906), exp 12 bank from the exp 28 recompute stmt28_12_ij2_lang.json (0.9955); no per-item probe scores are saved, so no interval. Statement shift: exp 18 fixed from instruments18.json (0.5075; exp 28 recompute 0.5115), exp 12 fixed and both paraphrase means from stmt28_*_ij2_lang.json. J-enrichment: exp 02 gates.json lang G2 diff-means r1536 = 1.730 (r384 = 3.317), exp 18 instruments18.json jenr = 1.376 (r = 1536, as in modal18.py) with decide.jenr = false. Record discrepancy: the talk script calls this row J-enriched; exp 02's gate supports that, exp 18's own instrument does not (1.38 < 1.5), so exp 18 predicted the J-lens cell high only through the statement shift. Exp 12 has no J-enrichment instrument for this row, hence exp 02 in that slot. Free readouts: judged/ij2_lang_{nla,ol42}.json in exps 12 and 18; same counting as g2_common.states_rate. Oracle Lens states: exp 12 1 of 320, exp 18 1 of 320.
